key_points: A likely Fed hike and 10-year yields above 5% raise discount rates and pressure SPY valuations.
The hike appears largely anticipated, limiting downside unless policy guidance is more hawkish than expected.
AI-slowdown fears and U.S.-Iran conflict costs add macro uncertainty, while stronger futures provide a near-term offset.
Wells Fargo's bearish call and roughly 12% overvaluation estimates reinforce multiple-compression risk but are not independently decisive.
Most other headlines concern individual holdings, mixed breadth, or trading flow and add little index-level signal.
